title: Morning rush in New York City: every train, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in New York City, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every train inside the city on an average October weekday.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the New York City limits are faded and not counted. Colours: B/D/F/M, 4/5/6, 1/2/3, N/Q/R/W, A/C/E and 7, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment of the morning: 590 trains at 8:25 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out Columbus Day (October 12).
